subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new opt-in `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` provider-dispatch config surface as the first phase of outbound API governance?
rationale: The code path is plausible, but adding a provider config contract and local admission behavior is product/API direction, and the open canonical issue still spans broader budgets, tools/channels, backoff, and status UX.

options.title: Accept Provider Dispatch First
options.body: Approve this opt-in model-provider HTTP slice after rebase, with broader governance tracked separately.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Ask the author to remove or rename config/API pieces until maintainers settle the broader outbound governance shape.

options.title: Defer To Canonical Tracker
options.body: Pause or close this PR and keep design work on the broader rate-limit tracker until the full scope is decided.

recommendation.title: Accept Provider Dispatch First
recommendation.body: Approve this opt-in model-provider HTTP slice after rebase, with broader governance tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the overlapping provider egress/security boundary that constrains this merge.
